update.title: Archived Website Notice
update.contentHTML: You are viewing the archived version of GeneraTOR, which contains the obsolete train order format that is no longer used on the Polish Railway Lines (PLK) network or in the simulator. Use these written orders only if you want to recreate railway operations before July 1, 2026, for example during sessions on sceneries dated before this time.
update.disclaimerHTML: This website is no longer updated with new features or security patches. Use it at your own risk!
update.linkHTML: Link to the website with the new train order format currently used on the Polish railway network: GeneraTOR
